## Summary

Describe the change and why it exists.

## Type Of Change

- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Refactor
- [ ] Test only
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] CI/CD
- [ ] Hotfix

## Validation

- [ ] `mvn -B verify`
- [ ] Manual smoke test completed when applicable
- [ ] Security-sensitive paths were exercised

## Checklist

- [ ] Branch follows the naming convention in `CONTRIBUTING.md`
- [ ] Commits are clean and reviewable
- [ ] Tests were added or updated where behavior changed
- [ ] Docs were updated where API or workflow changed
- [ ] No credentials, secrets, or machine-local files were added

## Notes For Reviewers

Call out anything risky, incomplete, or worth special attention.
